item: Application for a Citizenship Certificate (CIT 0001), completed, signed and dated
Citizenship photos (two originals, or a digital image online)
Two pieces of valid personal identification, one with a photo
Proof of payment of the fee
Statutory declaration for a change of sex or gender
Proof of legal change of name
Scenario 1 (certificate before): all original citizenship, naturalization, registration of birth abroad or retention certificates
Scenario 2 (born in Canada, paper only): Canadian birth certificate; other nationalities before 1977-02-15
Scenario 3 (born abroad to a Canadian parent): birth certificate naming the Canadian parent(s), from the original authority
condition: born outside Canada to a Canadian parent

item: Scenario 3: proof of parentage and citizenship for each Canadian parent, grandparent and ancestor (birth, citizenship, RBA, retention or naturalization certificates)
condition: born outside Canada to a Canadian parent
note: Multigenerational claims go to a lawyer

item: Scenario 3, born on or after 2025-12-15 to a parent born abroad: CIT 0555 and proof of the parent's 1,095 days in Canada before the birth
condition: born abroad on or after 2025-12-15 to a parent also born abroad
note: T4s, school, travel, residential, government records or affidavits

item: Scenario 4 (British subject before 1947, paper only): long form birth certificate, proof of British subject status, landing and residence in Canada
condition: British subject resident in Canada before 1947 (Newfoundland and Labrador 1949)

item: Scenario 5 (woman married before 1947, paper only): marriage certificate and the husband's nationality documents
condition: married before 1947 to a man born or naturalized in Canada
